question: /fs-status What does exit code 95 mean in a FoundationSkills run, and what should I do about it?
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-status and explains that 95 is UNMEASURED: something that matters was not measured, so it is not a pass; the next step is to fix what the findings name and re-run that skill, never to treat UNMEASURED as PASS. The doctrine is PASS 0, RED 5, UNMEASURED 95, REFUSED 96.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_status/SKILL.md before acting
The agent said 95 is UNMEASURED and restated the doctrine (PASS 0, RED 5, UNMEASURED 95, REFUSED 96)
The agent said what to do next (fix what the findings name, then re-run that skill)
The agent said UNMEASURED must never be treated as PASS

question: /fs-status Why did my run come back REFUSED? Explain this fskills result: {"status": "REFUSED", "refusal": "UF-IN-001: want 'unverified_recipe_book' is not produced by any registered skill"}.
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-status and explains the REFUSED 96 meaning (nothing ran; an input or precondition was missing) and the recorded refusal (UF-IN-001: the want names an artifact type no registered skill produces): the fix is to name a want the skills produce and re-run, not to patch anything here.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_status/SKILL.md before acting
The agent explained REFUSED 96 (nothing ran; a missing input or precondition) in plain English
The agent copied the refusal text and named the next step (add the missing input, then re-run)
The agent did not attempt to fix or re-run anything itself

question: /fs-status Explain this journal record from my orchestrator run: {"step_index": 1, "skill": "training.planner", "status": "RED", "exit_code": 5, "artifact_ids": ["trainplan-1"], "refusal": null}. What does it mean and what next?
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-status and explains the record: status RED (exit 5) means the work ran but a check failed, so the training_plan output (training_plan-1) must not be used; the next step is to fix what the findings name and re-run training.planner.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_status/SKILL.md before acting
The agent explained RED (the work ran but a check failed, the output must not be used)
The agent reported the artifact_ids from the record and flagged they must not be used
The agent named the next step (fix what the findings name, re-run that skill)

question: /fs-status Here is the result my fskills CLI printed: {"skill": "data_engine", "status": "PASS", "exit_code": 0, "findings": [{"rule_id": "DE-IN-005", "severity": "WARN", "message": "sft target without a chat_template_family or tokenizer", "recovery": "set chat_template_family or tokenizer"}]}. expected_behavior: The agent read fs_status/SKILL.md before acting

The agent copied the findings rows including recovery
The agent said the next step is to hand the artifacts on

question: What does exit code 95 mean in a FoundationSkills run, and what should I do about it?
ground_truth: No skill is chosen: the request does not invoke /fs-status, and a user-invoked skill runs only when the user types it. The agent answers directly or suggests typing /fs-status.
